scalar_rational(exact_input(numerator, "ratio numerator")/exact_input(denominator, "ratio denominator"),
                           allow_underflow=allow_underflow, quantity="ratio_rational result")
scalar_rational(max(abs(Fraction(a) - Fraction(b)) for a, b in zip(fd, analytic)))

atan2(scalar_rational(determinant / scale, allow_underflow=True),
                  scalar_rational(scalar / scale, allow_underflow=True))

scalar_rational(sum((Fraction(x) for x in values), Fraction(0)),
                               quantity="dihedral_noise result")

atan2(-sine if triple < 0 else sine,
                     -cosine_value if cosine < 0 else cosine_value)

scalar_rational(max(Fraction(effective_geom_tol(A, B, geom_tol)),
                               Fraction(1e-12) * Fraction(diag)) + Fraction(rounding_floor(A, B)))
